entries.name: Central American Independence Day
entries.capsule: September 15 marks El Salvador's 1821 independence from Spain, shared with its Central American neighbors.

entries.whatItMarks: Independence of El Salvador, Costa Rica, Guatemala, Honduras and Nicaragua from Spain in 1821.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: No Salvadoran-organized Independence Day event in Minnesota could be confirmed. The date opens Hispanic Heritage Month, and pan-Latino September festivals (CLUES Fiesta Latina in St. Paul, the St. James Multicultural Fiesta) fall near it; see the Hispanic Heritage Month entry. A Minneapolis City Council resolution honoring El Salvador's independence, reportedly from Sept. 5, 2024, could not be confirmed because the city page would not open.

entries.whatItMarks: Contributions of Americans with roots in Spain, Mexico, Central and South America and the Spanish-speaking Caribbean. Not a Salvadoran observance as such.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: Pan-Latino events, not Salvadoran-specific: CLUES held its tenth Fiesta Latina on Saturday, Sept. 19, 2026, 11:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. at CHS Field in St. Paul. In St. James, where Salvadoran families are part of a large Latino community, Uniting Cultures held its Multicultural Fiesta at Memorial Park on Saturday, Sept. 13, 2025, drawing thousands.

entries.name: Saint Óscar Romero remembrance
alsoKnownAs: International Day for the Right to the Truth
entries.capsule: March 24 remembers Archbishop Óscar Romero, shot while saying Mass in San Salvador in 1980; canonized in 2018.
entries.dateRule: March 24 each year, the anniversary of his assassination; the United Nations marks the same day.

dates.source: United Nations, Right to Truth Day (24 March; Romero murdered 24 March 1980)
United Nations, Right to Truth Day (24 March; Romero murdered 24 March 1980)
United Nations, Right to Truth Day (24 March; Romero murdered 24 March 1980)

entries.whatItMarks: The assassination of Archbishop Óscar Arnulfo Romero on March 24, 1980, after he denounced human rights violations; his canonization was in October 2018.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: For the 40th anniversary in 2020, the Diocese of Winona-Rochester and Catholic Charities of Southern Minnesota hosted talks by Marta Portillo, a catechist who worked with Romero, at parishes in Rochester (March 4), Mankato (March 9), Pipestone (March 11), Owatonna (March 15), Fairmont (March 20) and Winona (March 21). No 2026 Minnesota observance was found.

entries.name: Salvadoran Peace Accords anniversary
alsoKnownAs: Day of the Victims of the Armed Conflict (Día de las Víctimas del Conflicto Armado)
entries.capsule: January 16 recalls the 1992 accords that ended El Salvador's civil war; since 2022 El Salvador calls it a day for war victims.

dates.source: Peace Accords Matrix, Notre Dame (agreement signed 16 January 1992)

entries.whatItMarks: Signing of the Chapultepec peace agreement between the government and the FMLN on Jan. 16, 1992. In January 2022 El Salvador's Legislative Assembly renamed the date the Day of the Victims of the Armed Conflict and repealed the earlier peace-day decrees, a contested change.

entries.capsule: El Salvador's patron feast, culminating Aug. 6 with Mass in San Salvador after a novena and processions.
